description_en: Queries the applications that an EIAM account can access and returns a paginated list of application IDs. To retrieve detailed information about a specific application, call the GetApplication operation
description_zh: 分页查询一个EIAM账户可访问的应用列表。返回的结果中，包含应用ID信息，如需获取应用详细信息，请调用GetApplication接口
kebab_example: aliyun eiam list-applications-for-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --application-ids app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --query-mode OnlyDirect --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplicationsForUser

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of application IDs. You can specify up to 100 application IDs in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID列表，单次操作最多支持100个应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en:
The query mode. Default value: OnlyDirect. Valid values:

OnlyDirect: Queries only the direct permissions of the account. Direct permissions are granted for applications that are directly assigned to the account.

IncludeInherit: Queries both the direct and inherited permissions of the account. Inherited permissions are granted from the parent organizations or groups to which the account belongs
parameters.help_zh:
查询模式，默认为 OnlyDirect ，取值可选范围：

OnlyDirect：代表只查询账户的直属权限，即直接分配给账户的应用。
IncludeInherit：代表既查询账户的直属权限，也查询账户的继承权限。继承权限是指账户通过其父级组织（或者其隶属的组）继承的权限
parameters.name: query_mode
